title: International Economist
description:
The National Foreign Affairs Training Center of the U.S. Department of State seeks a Ph.D. economist with an outstanding teaching record, a strong interest in innovative curriculum design, and excellent communication skills for the position of International Economist in the Economic and Commercial Studies Division. The individual will be part of a team that teaches U.S. career diplomats, whose work as economic officers domestically and abroad.  Full details on this position and how to apply can be found on USAJobs.gov, search Announcement Number E/OCE-DHA-2027-0003.
 
The successful candidate should have several years of teaching experience at the advanced undergraduate and/or Master's level with an emphasis on practical applications. Individual must have a strong background in basic Micro and Macro Theory in addition to her/his field of expertise and be flexible enough to teach on a range of applied policy topics within foreign affairs.  (Recent examples include supply chains and the digital economy.)  Position is a two-year appointment with renewal options of up to five-year appointments and requires U.S. citizenship. 

Candidates should submit application materials through USAJobs.gov  by 12/18/2026.
